name: done-gate
description: Claude cannot say "done" while the tests fail: a Stop gate runs your test command after every turn that changed files, and existing test files are locked so they cannot be patched green.

checkCommand.title: Check command
checkCommand.description: Shell command the gate runs, e.g. "npm test && npm run typecheck". Empty: detect from package.json, pyproject.toml/pytest.ini/setup.cfg, Cargo.toml or go.mod.

timeoutSeconds.title: Check timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one check run may take before it counts as failed. At most 600.

maxRounds.title: Max rounds
maxRounds.description: How many times per prompt the gate sends Claude back to fix failing checks before it lets it stop anyway.

lockTests.title: Lock test files
lockTests.description: Deny edits, deletes and moves of existing test files. New test files can still be created.

testGlobs.title: Test file globs
testGlobs.description: Comma-separated globs relative to the project root. Empty: **/*.test.*, **/*.spec.*, **/test_*.py, **/*_test.py, **/*_test.go, **/tests/**, **/__tests__/**, **/spec/**.

gate.title: Done gate
gate.description: on runs the checks when Claude stops after changing files; off keeps only the test lock.
